run_bm_sample_pdf: run the bm_sample_pdf benchmark across python_cuda, cuda, python_cpu, and cpu backends
test_bm_fn: test the TestSamplePDF bm_fn with custom backend, n_samples, batch_size, and n_bins kwargs
benchmark_sample_pdf_backends: benchmark sample_pdf across all four backends with varying batch sizes and bin counts
review_bm_sample_pdf: review the bm_sample_pdf function to understand its test case generation using itertools.product
refactor_bm_sample_pdf: refactor bm_sample_pdf to add or remove backends, sample counts, batch sizes, or bin counts
